specific_objectives: 11.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain aircraft structure, various structural elements and their details.

intro_questions: What is the primary function of the fuselage?
Name three main structural elements of the fuselage.
How does fuselage shape affect aircraft performance?

development.content:
Fuselage introduction and definition
Fuselage shape variations
Structural design principles
Detailed design layout components

Load distribution in fuselage
Skin and frame interaction

Material selection criteria

Fuselage assembly sequence
Quality control measures
Maintenance considerations
Future design trends

summary_questions: Explain the role of the fuselage in aircraft structure.
Describe how fuselage shape influences aerodynamic efficiency.
